questions.question: Where did Will find himself after falling asleep while studying storms?
questions.explanation: 威尔研究天气睡着后，梦中站在热气球篮子里。

questions.question: Why did QT tell Will to turn on the balloon's burners?
options: To warm the air so the balloon would stay up
questions.explanation: 燃烧器给球内空气加热，热空气更轻，有助于气球上升。

questions.question: How did QT explain the creation of wind?
options: By the moon pulling the clouds
Warm air rises and cooler air moves into its place
questions.explanation: 太阳加热不同地区程度不同，热空气上升、冷空气流入，从而形成风。

questions.question: Why did QT urge Will to land as the thundercloud approached?
options: The balloon had lost its basket
They could be in danger if the cloud produced lightning
questions.explanation: 雷云靠近，QT担心热气球在空中遭遇闪电，建议降落。

questions.question: Why did Will hear thunder after seeing lightning?
options: Thunder is created the next day
questions.explanation: QT说明光传播比声音快，所以先看到闪电，后听到雷声。

questions.question: Why did QT say mosquitoes should not all disappear?
options: They help make the rain fall
They are the only animals in wetlands
Other species depend on them for food
questions.explanation: QT解释蚊子是食物链一环，许多鸟和鱼以它们为食。

questions.question: Where did QT say Will was canoeing?
questions.explanation: 威尔在佛罗里达大沼泽地乘独木舟。

questions.question: How did QT explain that wetlands can help prevent flooding?
options: They absorb extra rainwater and release it slowly
They block all rain from falling
questions.explanation: 湿地像海绵一样吸收暴雨的多余水分，再缓慢释放。

questions.question: What important role did QT describe for mangrove roots?
options: They help keep soil from being washed away
questions.explanation: 红树林的根能稳固泥土，减少水流冲刷。

questions.question: How did Will feel about wetlands when he woke?
options: He still thought they were useless
He wanted to destroy the mosquitoes
He refused to write his report
He understood they were valuable and began writing about them
questions.explanation: 梦醒后威尔改变看法，认为湿地和蚊子并非毫无用处，开始写报告。

questions.question: What did Will use to think about Earth moving around the Sun?
questions.explanation: 威尔把篮球当太阳、棒球当地球，试着理解太阳与地球的运动。

questions.question: What did QT say actually causes day and night?
questions.explanation: QT说昼夜交替来自地球绕自转轴旋转，而不是太阳绕地球转。

questions.question: How did QT explain the different phases of the Moon?
options: The Moon changes its shape every day
The Moon grows smaller each night
The Sun turns the Moon on and off
We see different amounts of its sunlit half as it orbits
questions.explanation: 月球本身形状不变，而是我们看到受光部分的比例在变化。

questions.question: What did QT identify as the main cause of Earth's seasons?
options: The Earth growing farther away every day
The Moon passing in front of the Sun
Earth's axis being tilted as it moves around the Sun
The clouds becoming heavier in winter
questions.explanation: 地轴倾斜使地球绕日运行时南北半球受太阳直射程度不同，因此出现季节。

questions.question: What danger suddenly threatened Will and QT near the Sun?
options: The spaceship was pulled toward the Sun by gravity
The ship ran out of water
questions.explanation: 飞船离太阳太近，被太阳引力拉向太阳。
